_comment: Charter player text. Copied to config/charter/en_us.json on first boot; edit that copy. Placeholders in braces are filled in. A refusal can be reworded by adding reason.<key>.
page.title: Charter
link.collect_hover: Take what you are owed into your inventory
link.expired: That link has run out. Open the page again.
found.done: You founded {name}. Invite a second member to make it active.
invite.no_player: Nobody called {name} has been seen on this server.
grant.bad_power: That is not a power. Type the command again and pick one from the list.
grant.no_target: No player or office is called {name}.
vote.state.refused_at_execution: passed, but could not be carried out
votes.title: Open votes
votes.none: There is nothing for you to vote on.
votes.abstain_hover: Count toward quorum without taking a side
vault.title: The vault
vault.bad_currency: The vault takes cobblestone and diamonds.
vault.owed_left: Your inventory is full. Make room, then collect the rest from /charter vault.
notice.invited: {org} invited you to join. Type /charter to answer.
notice.activated: {org} has its second member and is now active.
notice.vote_opened: A vote opened in {org}: {about}. Type /charter vote to cast yours.
notice.vote_refused: A vote in {org} passed, but could not be carried out: {about}.
notice.office_filled: You now hold the office of {office} in {org}.
notice.office_vacated: You no longer hold the office of {office} in {org}.
notice.camp_raised: {org} has raised a camp against you: {site}. Patrol the walls and stock the granary.
notice.encircled: {site} is encircled. Nothing can be carried in until the ring is broken.
notice.starving: {site} is starving. Below a quarter of its stores, it can be stormed.
notice.cut_off: Your camp {site} is cut off. Nothing can reach it and it burns its food twice as fast.
notice.camp_empty: Your camp {site} has run out of food and no longer besieges anyone.
notice.camp_exposed: Your camp {site} has been broken by a sally. Its banner can be taken.
notice.hold_emptied: {org} raided your land at chunk {x}, {z} until it held no more. It is no longer yours.
notice.keep_fell_ours: {site} has fallen to you. Choose whether to raze or occupy it.
notice.occupied: {org} occupies {site}. It is still yours on record; take it back by siege or wait out the occupation.
notice.occupying: You occupy {site}. Its granary and walls are yours to hold until the occupation ends.
notice.truce: Your siege of {site} is lifted. A truce bars you from it for a while.
notice.contested: {count} of your claims lost their link to a keep. Link them again before the grace runs out.
notice.lapsed: {count} of your claims were lost: the grace ran out.
power.choose_fall: decide the fate of a fallen keep
motion.unknown: something this server no longer knows
motion.election: elect someone to the office of {office}
motion.contract.breach: declare a breach of a contract
admin.advanced: Siege time moved on by {by}. The siege clock is at {siege}.
admin.scaled: Time scale is {scale} until the server restarts. Set timeScale in charter.json to keep it.
admin.not_member: {player} is not a member of anything.
admin.aged: The membership of {player} now dates back {days} days further.
admin.repaired: Repair found {count} thing(s) to put right. Each is in history.jsonl.
land.protected: This land belongs to {owner}. You may walk here, not build.
land.item.nexus_lore: Place it to raise a keep: nine chunks around it become your faction's.
land.item.banner_lore: Plant it to raise a camp. Anyone can pull it down while it raises.
land.nexus_placed: The keep of {org} stands. Its nine chunks are claimed.
land.nexus_unbreakable: The nexus cannot be broken while its keep stands.
land.camp_raising: Your camp is raising. It takes {hours} hours, and until then anyone can pull the banner down.
land.camp_cut_down: You pulled the banner down. The camp is gone.
land.banner_stays: The banner of a raised camp stands until a sally leaves the camp exposed.
land.camp_broken: The camp's guard was worn down. You broke its banner and the camp is gone.
land.admin.spawned: {name} is founded, funded, and {player} holds a nexus and a war banner.
land.admin.no_core: There is no keep or camp.
land.admin.raised: {camp} finished raising ({by} of siege time passed).
map.legend: @ you   K keep core   k keep   C camp   o farm   + free and next to your land (click to claim)   . free   green yours, red theirs
map.free_claimable: Chunk {x}, {z}: free. Click to claim it.
granary.title: Granary
granary.fallen: Fallen: whoever holds the keep may take what is left
granary.cut_off: Cut off: burning twice as fast
granary.camp_empty: Empty: this camp can no longer besiege
granary.may_take: You may put food in and take it out.
granary.may_not_take: You may put food in. Taking it out needs the granary withdraw power.
granary.carry_rule: Under siege, food goes in only if it was carried in through an open side.
granary.returned: Some of that food was not accepted and has been given back.
granary.locked: That store belongs to someone else while their keep stands.
granary.linked: This chest is now part of your keep's granary.
granary.linked_camp: This is now your camp's store.
granary.already: That container is already part of a granary.
granary.wrong_chunk: A granary stands in its keep's core chunk, a camp store in the banner's chunk.
granary.not_a_container: That is not a chest or a barrel.
granary.full: A granary takes at most {max} chests.
granary.not_touching: That chest does not touch the granary, so it stays an ordinary chest.
granary.no_banner: A camp store must stand beside the war banner.
granary.no_core_here: No keep or camp has its core chunk here.
granary.set: The container at {x} {y} {z} is now part of the granary or camp store.
granary.removed: The container at {x} {y} {z} is no longer part of a granary.
granary.not_a_granary: There is no granary or camp store container there.
granary.none: No granary or camp store is set.
granary.list_line: {core}: {count} container(s) from {x} {y} {z}, {queued} item(s) queued for the next load
supply.ender_chest: An ender chest cannot be opened here while the siege lasts. Food must come in through an open side.
supply.allowance: {carrier} may put in {items} for {minutes} more siege minutes
cell.bad_name: Name a cell with 1 to {max} characters, no bars.
cell.no_power: Only a judge may mark or remove a cell.
cell.not_your_keep: Stand inside one of your own keeps to mark a cell.
cell.exists: This keep already has a cell called {name}.
cell.start_blocked: Stand in open air with room for your head, inside the keep, to mark a cell.
cell.leaks: That space is not closed in. Walls, floor and ceiling must stop every way out, inside the keep.
cell.too_big: That space is too big or not closed in. A cell holds at most {max} blocks of air.
cell.marked: Cell {name} marked in {site}: {count} blocks of air. Prisoners are put where you stood.
cell.removed: Cell {name} is no longer a cell.
cell.unknown: Your faction has no cell called {name}.
cell.none: Your faction has no cells. Stand in a closed room in a keep and type /charter cell mark <name>.
arrest.done: {player} is in your custody. Sentence them before the custody lapses.
jail.leashed: The lead pulls you back to your captor.
jail.returned: You are put back in your cell.
jail.escaped: You are out of the cell. Nobody can call that a crime.
jail.freed: You are free. You are led out of the cell.
jail.tethered: You may not leave the keep you are bonded to.
jail.no_teleport: You cannot teleport while you are held.
jail.no_commands: You cannot use commands while you are held. Only /charter works.
execution.wait: You were executed. You wait {time} before you may act again.
banish.pushed: You are banished from that land and were sent back.
notice.arrested: {officer} of {org} has taken you into custody. A judge must sentence you soon or you go free. Teleports and commands are blocked.
notice.custody_lapsed: Nobody sentenced you in time. You are free.
notice.fined: {org} fined you {asked} diamonds. {paid} were taken from your safe.
justice.in_custody: {player} is in custody, {time} left to sentence.
justice.link_pardon_hover: End every sentence your organization or one below it imposed
justice.nobody: Nobody is in custody or held. Use a lead on someone standing on your land to arrest them.
justice.sentence_info: Custody lapses in {time}. This week they may still be punished for {week}.
justice.row_execute: Execute: a wait of {wait}, then banished for {banish}.
justice.link_bond_hover: Tether {player} to the keep so they work its land
justice.link_execute_hover: Kill {player} once; they keep their items
justice.link_fine_hover: Fine {player}; nothing is taken if their safe is empty
safe.balance: {count} diamonds. A fine is taken from here and nowhere else.
war.raze_hover: Break the nexus and unclaim its nine chunks
war.occupy_hover: Hold the keep and its granary for a while; it stays theirs on record
war.choice_refused: That choice is no longer open.
chronicle.players_only: Only a player can be handed a book.
chronicle.no_faction: You are not in a faction. The realm's Chronicle is /charter chronicle realm.
chronicle.realm_blocked: Something is in the way. Stand in open air.
chronicle.realm_placed: The Realm Chronicle now stands at {x} {y} {z}.
chronicle.realm_removed: That lectern no longer keeps the Realm Chronicle.
chronicle.realm_none_near: No Realm Chronicle lectern within 3 blocks.
chronicle.realm_empty: No Realm Chronicle lecterns yet. Use /charter admin realm-chronicle here.
scenario.unknown: There is no scenario called {name}. Try /charter admin scenario list.
scenario.stopped: The scenario stopped there. Fix that and run /charter admin scenario clear before trying again.
scenario.cleared: Took down {count} factions made by scenarios.
scenario.too_many_players: {count} players were named, but the scenario has only {roles} roles.
scenario.already_member: {player} already belongs to {org}. Run /charter admin scenario clear, or leave first.
scenario.cast_stand_ins: {count} roles are played by offline stand-ins.
scenario.no_role: The scenario names a role {role} that is not in any faction or among the outsiders.
scenario.no_faction: The scenario names a faction {faction} it never founds.
scenario.raised: Raised every camp: the siege clock moved on {hours} hours.
scenario.rails_straight: Rails run along one axis only.

book.home.title: {org}

book.found.need_diamonds: A keep costs {price} diamonds. You carry {have}.
